newsitem.title: INDIA: India castor prices in gains on speculative buying.
newsitem.headline: India castor prices in gains on speculative buying.

text.p: Indian castorseed September delivery prices on Tuesday swung back to gains, rising to 1,128/1,130 rupees per quintal from 1,120/1,122 rupees on fresh speculative buying, dealers said.
"Technically the market is oversold and reports of a drop in arrivals at producing centres, prompted short covering," one dealer said.
Castorseed arrivals fell on heavy inflows.
"Indian exporters are offering castoroil at 697/698 dollars per tonne but foreign buyers are not interested --- they are just waiting and watching," he said.
Groundnut oil was steady at 349/350 rupees per 10 kg amidst thin arrivals of 40/50 tonnes while the offtake was at low ebb.
In Rajkot spot groundnut oil was steady at 550 rupees per 15 kg.

In Bombay, imported palm oil fell to 260 rupees per 10 kg from 264/265 rupees as fresh losses in the world market triggered renewed offerings by local importers. Dull physical demand too aided the weak sentiment.
"Buyers kept away expecting a further price erosion," one importer said.
